title: FD002 core manuscript evidence v1

papers.title: Anomaly Detection and Remaining Useful Life Prediction for Turbofan Engines with a Key Point-Based Approach to Secure Health Management
papers.research_task: key-point anomaly/degradation analysis and RUL planning
